description: This file defines a custom Android UI component 'LogView' that extends TextView and implements the LogNode interface. It is designed to display log messages received from logging facilities, formatting messages based on priority, tags, and exceptions, and displaying them in a UI element within an Android activity.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying log messages, implementing the LogNode interface, formatting log data, and supporting chain chaining with the next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data (priority, tag, message, exception) and appends it to the LogView, also forwarding the log to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string and delimiter to a StringBuilder if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
